ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Every year is a good year is a calendrical formula paired with every day being a good day, then challenged, answered, and mocked in New Year interviews.
EvidenceBody: An unnamed monk presents the year-and-day pair to Chushi Fanqi, who answers with the image of a blind old woman blowing a fire. Another New Year exchange asks why there is no teaching if every year and day is good; Mingjiao answers that Zhang drinks while Li gets drunk.

Huqiu Shaolong expands the formula through every month, day, and hour after asking whether the assembly has entered the gateless gate. Recurrence therefore does not make it bland seasonal optimism: the saying remains a claim that masters publicly test.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: A festive good-year wish becomes encounter material whose smooth assurance draws deliberately abrasive answers.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The cases do not let the sentence stand as automatic blessing; they challenge its speaker and redirect the claim.

DifferentThingTest.Reason: The tests quote the same calendrical saying.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The aliases expose the yearly line, its daily companion, and its New Year interview setting.

ModifierControls.Control: 年年 distributes the claim over every year
ModifierControls.Finding: Its absolute recurrence is what questioners bring to New Year interviews.

FamilyControls.Finding: Every day is a good day is the fixed companion.
Every month is good extends the same formula.
